snippet.title: Putin’s Offensive Is Dead... Russia Is Now LOSING Ground
snippet.description:
Ten months. Hundreds of thousands of soldiers. And only 119 square kilometers gained. Russia’s 2026 offensive was supposed to capture Donetsk by spring. Instead, Putin’s army is now losing ground, month after month. 🔥

In this video, we break down exactly what happened across Sumy, Lyman, the Fortress Belt, and Dobropillia in early November, and why the ISW says Russia failed to advance anywhere. You will see the October numbers that stunned analysts, why Donetsk could take 31 more years at the current pace, and the two reasons Russia’s offensive stalled: Ukraine’s counterattacks and Russia’s own exhausted army.

⚡ In this video:

Russia’s failed attacks on November 3 and 4
Why Russia’s October territorial figures swung to a net loss
Operation Vivaldi and Ukraine’s 1,022 km² of liberated land
Record Russian casualties in October and November
The gap between Russia’s claims and reality on the map
What 2027 could look like for the Kremlin
